headline: Allocation of $400,000 in underspent school funds, English learner program review, and proposed 2026-2027 superintendent goals.
summary: The agenda covers a $400,000 allocation of underspent school funds, a request to discuss e-bikes and scooters, and a DESE review of the English learner program. An executive session will cover union bargaining, litigation, and contract talks with non-union staff.
items: Consent agenda: October 2026 warrants and grants
DESE review of English learner program
Annual report on school resource officers
Allocation of $400,000 in net school spending underspent funds
Request to discuss e-bikes and scooters, referred to Public Facilities and Safety Subcommittee
Executive session on collective bargaining and litigation, including City of Malden v. Supervisor of Public Records and Social Media Litigation
Executive session on Malden Education Association Building Monitors bargaining
Executive session on contract negotiations with non-union personnel
location: Herbert L. Jackson Council Chamber Room 106, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden
